title: Telegram forwarding uses a durable cursor and bounded after-cursor reads, so responses outside the 20-message tail aren't silently skipped
outcome: Telegram forwarding never silently skips assistant output when the tracked message falls outside the default 20-message REST tail. It reads after a durable cursor with explicit gaps, delivers in order, and avoids duplicates.
acceptance: Telegram forwarding uses a durable cursor and bounded indexed after-cursor/turn reads with explicit gaps. With >20 nontext/new messages and cursor outside tail, restart, partial-chunk failure and duplicate delivery, eligible responses are delivered in order without silent rebasing loss or duplicate acknowledged chunks; no full transcript hydration.
The focused regressions and the full gate pass on the final input, and an independent read-only review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
